تدافعت (form VI)
# تَدَافَعْتُ (tadāfaʕtu) /ta.daː.faʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تَدَافَعْتَ (tadāfaʕta) /ta.daː.faʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تَدَافَعْتِ (tadāfaʕti) /ta.daː.faʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تَدَافَعَتْ (tadāfaʕat) /ta.daː.fa.ʕat/: third-person fem
